texts.Route131_Text_RichardIntro: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.$
texts.Route131_Text_RichardDefeat: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough…$
texts.Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle:
Gasp… Gasp…
I'm wiped out…\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make
the return trip?$

texts.Route131_Text_HermanIntro: The sea… The sea… The sea…\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\lI'm sick and tired of the sea!$
texts.Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\pI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.$

texts.Route131_Text_SusieIntro: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!$
texts.Route131_Text_SusieDefeat: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!$
texts.Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\pThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!$

texts.Route131_Text_KaraIntro: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\pThey all ogle me!$
texts.Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!$

texts.Route131_Text_ReliIntro: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!$
texts.Route131_Text_ReliDefeat: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together…$
texts.Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.$
texts.Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\lthe time they are born.$

texts.Route131_Text_IanIntro: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!$
texts.Route131_Text_IanDefeat: IAN: I did my best with my sis,\nbut we still couldn't win…$
texts.Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons: IAN: If you have two POKéMON,\nwe'll take you on!$
texts.Route131_Text_IanPostBattle: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\pSo, wherever there is the sea,\nthat's a part of PACIFIDLOG!$

texts.Route131_Text_KevinIntro: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\na peaceful bunch.\pThey never get angry.\nThat goes for me, too.$
texts.Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle: Tch! …Oh, wait.\nI'm not angry. Honestly!\pBut, boy, you're strong!\nHahaha!$

texts.Route131_Text_TaliaIntro: If you can beat me, I'll give you some\ngreat information!$
texts.Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle: There is an odd place nearby.\nThere's a huge tower there.\lWhy don't you go take a look?$
